principle: "Use the environment's supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, and open a container before accessing it. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar but different objects may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks."

S6 Failure Lesson:
title: "Recover from no-change actions by changing location, state, or strategy"
description: "When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. After a failed placement, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted."
why_it_happens: "The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy."
how_to_avoid: "After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object/container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty."

S7 Procedure:
title: "Use an acquire-then-operate sequence with explicit completion conditions"
principle: "For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen or when a container is opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Assign placement work only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object."
when_to_apply: "When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held."
